plan.title: feat(security): migrate intake/authz/escalation/scope ledgers to containedWrite (#2980 wave B)

narratives.Description: Residual #2980 wave B migrates intake, authz, escalation, and scope audit product write sinks onto containedWrite. These are durable ledger and grant paths that still use raw openSync/writeFileSync after Phase 2. Engine-only; siblings own init-deposit and eval.
narratives.Overview: Durable ledger and grant/escalation write sinks.
narratives.UserStory: As a security maintainer, I want intake and authz/escalation ledger writes on containedWrite, so that durable side files and grants refuse path escape.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Migrate packages/core/src/intake/issue-emit.ts, candidates-log.ts, github-body.ts product writes to containedWrite. Step 2: Migrate packages/core/src/authz/store.ts and packages/core/src/escalation/store.ts openSync/writeSync patterns to containedWrite or thin contained helpers. Step 3: Migrate packages/core/src/scope/audit-log.ts. Step 4: Tests + CHANGELOG #2980 wave B. Verify vitest on those packages and inventory drop. drive-to: merge-ready.

narrative.Acceptance: Given intake issue-emit and candidates-log write paths run, they call containedWrite (or approved contained helper) and tests return pass.
When authz/store and escalation/store persist records, they no longer use raw writeFileSync/openSync product paths without containment; tests return pass.
When scope audit-log appends, it uses containedWrite and inventory no longer flags scope/audit-log.ts.
When CHANGELOG.md is opened, it records an Unreleased entry that cites #2980 wave B.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/intake packages/core/src/authz packages/core/src/escalation packages/core/src/scope
